subject.title: [Feature]: Overview should show config file path

question: Should OpenClaw accept a prominent Control UI Overview row for the existing admin-scoped configPath snapshot field, move that visibility to Settings/Config, or keep the CLI-only path discovery surface?
rationale: The technical path is small and source-backed, but the requested prominence and placement are UX/product choices now that a CLI path command and an open UI PR both exist.

options.title: Accept the Overview row
options.body: Land the linked presentation-only UI change after proof confirms a running Control UI shows the active config path from the existing hello snapshot.

options.title: Move it to Settings or Config
options.body: Ask for the same existing snapshot/config path to be surfaced in a dedicated Settings or Config information row instead of the Overview snapshot card.

options.title: Keep CLI-only discovery
options.body: Decline the extra UI surface and treat `openclaw config file` as the supported troubleshooting path.

recommendation.title: Accept the Overview row
recommendation.body: Land the linked presentation-only UI change after proof confirms a running Control UI shows the active config path from the existing hello snapshot.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the strongest feature-history signal for the Overview UI structure that would receive this UX placement decision.
